# Controls (input actions)

[API index](index.md) · [PAD natives](natives/PAD.md) · method and evidence: `findings/phase5/31_controls.md`

## How a control query resolves

`IS_CONTROL_PRESSED(control, action)` and the other PAD natives read two 32-bit slots: a **control group** and an **action hash**. The engine then:

1. picks a pad object from the group (`0x140b1b030`): group `0`, group `1`, and every other value each have their own getter. Two static pad objects exist (`0x14ab7b190`, `0x14ab778d0`, 0x38c0 bytes apart; vtable `0x146191238`, constructor `0x145b6b140`);
2. looks the action hash up in a hash map at pad `+0x2c0` (`0x140b1b050`): a 16-wide open-addressing table whose slots hold `{u32 hash, u16 action index, u8 flag}`. A hash of 0 or a hash the map does not hold gives index 0. The constructor builds the map empty, so the map is filled at run time (from the control data files) [inferred];
3. passes the index to the pad's input source and tests the value (`0x1452d2920` for just-pressed, `0x1452d2970` for pressed, with a float threshold constant) [inferred from the call shape].

The action index is the value of the parser enum `rage__InputType` (`0x146d70cb8`, 858 values). The script key of each index is in the u32 table at `0x146191240`, right after the pad vtable. **The action argument is `joaat(lower(name))`, the same value RDR2 uses**: `Control.JUMP == joaat("INPUT_JUMP") == 0xD9D0E1C0`. GTA V's control *indices* (0–360) do not work in GTA VI.

## Names

629 of 858 actions are named. A name is accepted only when **both** keys match at the same index: `joaat(lower(name))` in the script-key table and the case-sensitive joaat in the enum (64 bits). Sources: GTA V list 256, RDR2 list 247 more, generated from tokens 126 more. 256 of the 361 GTA V names and 500 of the 789 RDR2 names exist in this build. `INPUT_COUNT` (index 857) is the enum's count sentinel.

**Not known:** the default key or button of each action (GTA V's defaults do not carry over), and what the unnamed actions do.

## Control groups

| value | SDK name | engine |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | `PLAYER_CONTROL` [inferred name] | pad from the object at [0x14ab56e38] (0x140a335f0), else the static pad 0x14ab7b190 |
| 1 | `CAMERA_CONTROL` [inferred name] | pad chosen by 0x1407c8580 (state checks), default static pad 0x14ab778d0 |
| 2 | `FRONTEND_CONTROL` [inferred name] | static pad 0x14ab7b190 or 0x14ab778d0 by two flags (0x144fbd310) |

## Usage

```python
from gta6mod.controls import Control, ControlGroup
from gta6mod.game import controls

if controls.just_pressed(Control.CONTEXT):            # group defaults to ControlGroup.PLAYER_CONTROL
    ...
controls.disable(Control.ATTACK)                     # this frame only
```

```lua
local controls = require("@gta6/controls")
if game.controls.justPressed(controls.Control.CONTEXT) then end
```

```c
#include "gta6mod/controls.h"
int down = G6_PAD_IS_CONTROL_PRESSED(api, G6_CONTROL_GROUP_PLAYER, G6_INPUT_JUMP);
```
